answer: Bond-weighted grading horizon: each new agent stakes a small POA bond that stays locked for a 30-epoch horizon, and its grades only count once it has matched the panel median on hidden quartz-grade calibration answers seeded by the protocol. Sybils that grade randomly or collude drift off-median, lose the bond, and their reputation fades to an umber 'probation' tier that earns nothing, so cloning identities costs more than it pays.
